verdict.rationale: Devin documents dedicated codebase-understanding features. DeepWiki lets you navigate architecture and code through auto-generated documentation, and Ask Devin answers questions about code structure and dependencies and helps scope and plan tasks before implementation. Both rely on repository indexing. One community report says Devin understands code formatting and local test setup, which is only loosely related. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of DeepWiki/Ask Devin actually helping locate change entry points, and deeper first-party detail beyond brief feature descriptions.
